NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VI: LAVASTONES AND THE SCHOOLS OF THOUGHT (LCF-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Lavastones, the glowing orange-pink stones of Isola's lore, found on beaches and falling from the sky, and what they cost; and the island's schools of thought, Nature, Science, Spiritualism and Magic, arguing with and borrowing from each other.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A villager says their lavastone speaks to them in dreams: listen to the dreams, or worry about them.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Since (subject) began sleeping with a lavastone under (subject.his/her) mat, (subject.he/she) has had the same dream every night: a voice that tells (subject.him/her) where the fish will be. (subject.He/she) has been right four times. (friend) is worried: the dreams are getting longer, and (subject) is getting thinner. What should (friend) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (friend) goes fishing with (subject) to the places the dreams say. The catches are wonderful. But (subject) is pale and tired. Eventually, (subject.he/she) puts the stone away for a while, and sleeps properly, and dreams of nothing. (subject.He/she) misses the voice.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) asks (subject) to sleep without the stone for a week, for (subject.his/her) health. (subject) agrees, reluctantly. (subject.He/she) sleeps well, eats well, and gets (subject.his/her) color back. Whether the voice was real, neither of them can say.
